name: code-input
title: CodeInput
description: A small code field on CodeMirror 6: one line (Enter submits) or several, PostgreSQL or JSON highlighting in the syntax.* colours, a read-only pretty viewer for JSON; themed through the token CSS variables and usable inside a Field.
usage: Use CodeInput for code that fits in a form: one-line SQL conditions and filters (Enter calls onSubmit), short JSON or SQL values (multiline, rows), and showing a cell or JSON value read-only (pretty pretty-prints JSON). Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel, like Input; the value is also in a hidden form control (name, required). Use SqlEditor for whole queries and Textarea for prose.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of a one-line field from size.control.* (density-aware); the padding of a multi-line one.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole text after every change.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Several lines, wrapped; Enter inserts a line break. One line otherwise: pasted line breaks become spaces.

props.name: rows
props.description: Minimum visible lines of a multi-line field, from text.code size and leading.

props.name: pretty
props.description: Read-only viewer: multi-line, JSON pretty-printed with two spaces (other text unchanged).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Text can be selected and copied but not changed; sets data-readonly and aria-readonly.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction, leaves the tab order, sets data-disabled.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty, in color.fg.subtle.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Enter in a one-line field; the text is not changed.

props.name: name
props.description: Form name of the hidden control that carries the value.

props.name: required
props.description: The value may not be empty; the Field validates it and the text area gets aria-required.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid outside a Field; inside a Field, its validation sets it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame: data-slot="code-input", data-size and the state attributes.

slots.name: editor
slots.description: data-slot="code-input-editor": where CodeMirror renders its text area (role textbox, contenteditable); its cm-* classes are CodeMirror's.

slots.name: control
slots.description: data-slot="code-input-control": the visually hidden Base UI Input (Field.Control) that carries the value, name and validity for forms and Fields.

states.name: focused
states.description: The text area has focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: multiline
states.description: Several lines: the height follows the content (at least rows lines) and the padding comes from space.inline.*.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Read-only (also in pretty mode): the inset background.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid: the danger border; inside a Field, its validation sets it.

accessibility: The text area is CodeMirror's contenteditable with role textbox and aria-multiline; inside a Field it takes the FieldLabel (aria-labelledby), the description and error (aria-describedby) and aria-invalid from the Field; on its own, give it aria-label.
Tab and Shift+Tab always leave the field (no indentation with Tab), so focus is never trapped; a FieldLabel click focuses the text area.
Enter submits a one-line field (onSubmit), as in a text input; in a multi-line one it inserts a line break. Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo.
Read-only and pretty fields stay focusable so the text can be read, selected and copied by keyboard (aria-readonly); disabled ones leave the tab order (aria-disabled).
Syntax colours are syntax.* roles, contrast-checked on the editor background in every mode; colour is never the only signal of an error (FieldError text, the danger border).
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring on the frame.
